review_description: Not installed yet. Due date is late January 2011 or so.Service is very professional and level of knowledge is high.I cannot comment on the execution of the installation as yet.

Went with SolarSA as they were the most experienced Company of the quotes I got.Unfortunately the original system design by the salesman was not possible due to insufficient pace on North facing roof and after being given an installation date was told on the morning of that day that they still had to work out how to do it. This resulted in waiting another month for installation (with a couple of rainy day appointments canceled). Installation was redesigned facing East but an extra Solar panel was put in at 1/2 price resulting in a 1.92 kW system.So main problem was waiting well over 2 months for installation.Installation was well done and after the first few days I am very happy with the performance of the system.

Too many companies, too many panel manufactures and too many inverters to choose from making it confusing as to what to select. Most companies state "German technology" use for the inverters and USA or the like for panels. However, just about everything offered is made in China or India.
We would recommend and use them again. The service was very good.

The SolarSA sales rep was the only one out of the three that actually got onto the roof and measured.  He also was very frank about how efficient the proposed solar system would be given I had one palm tree that could affect (the palm will be coming down soon).   He even met me in the city to sign off the paperwork and was very helpful with information.  All the paperwork arrived accordingly from the installers were professional, even helping replacing a cracked tile and explaining to me what they had done once the installation was complete.

Some suppliers offer lower wattage panels and this increases the surface area requirements (roof area) to fit them all on. This could present a real problem if you have a small roof area aligned with the sun. I have noticed a lot of panels are now China Supplied and the quality is not well known so I opted to buy from SolarSA for a proven supplier from Germany.
Solar SA were very professional, pricing very straightforward and staff helpful and informative. I had good referrals for Solar SA from a neighbour and family.

Can't say I enjoyed the experience.  None of the sales guys who came out to do quotes - invested me with any sense of confidence.  Conflicting advice about what we could/should have - trying to compare the different quotes in a meaningful way - in the end we just wanted to get it over and done with.
This sales person got up and measured roofspace, told us where the shade would be and that we needed to move our aerial. He seemed honest and straightforward.
Thank you Solar Quotes.

Both companies were comparable. Quoting staff on time, efficient, more than happy to answer any questions that were asked.  Both followed up from quoting.  Delivery was approx 8 weeks from accepting quote.
System has not yet been installed
Installation has not occurred yet so the QoS is subjective at this stage.
Salesperson took time to measure shade on roofspace, and design appropriate system layout, and explain quality and provenance of components.

I called one of your recommended suppliers; arranged an appointment, I waited for an hour called the representative at Solar Wholesaler to be advised he had overbooked his appointments, therefore not able to attend.I received no call to advise of time delay nor an apology or a suggestion for an alterative time.The other two providers were prompt helpful. (Solar SA & Adelaide Solar Systems)

The salesman was the most pleasant and competant person  that i have had the pleasure to do business with for a long time. His knowledge of the product and the ability to explain the various aspects of solar energy was outstanding
good non pushy salespeople, happy to get back to you to answer questions, quick and tidy installation.

This supplier calculated output for different placement of panels on roof, taking into account orientation and shading.I felt more comfortable with German panels than Chinese, which other suppliers quoted.

Your website provided two contacts in the area-only one responded and provided a verbal quote on details given by me.  I had done some research before hand ,asked friends about their systems and who they used etc. so I was semi-informed just needed to find out the finer details about rates etc. I had also run out of time to be available on-site for quotes .(we were also looking at insulation) In the end we just bit the bullet so to speak and went with the company offering a good quality system ,that would suit us right now and be of benefit in the years to come. We are very pleased with the product,it is unobtrusive and it is already saving us money and the environment.
I went back to good old fashion type sales, I found a good knowlegable local company
